errors.eq-sign-as-answer: Reads the equals sign as "the answer is" rather than as a balance
errors.dec-equal: Treats two different decimals as equal
errors.frac-mul-added: Adds the fractions instead of multiplying
errors.exp-partial: Multiplies only the first term inside the bracket
errors.gr-axes-swapped: Reads the axes the wrong way round
errors.expr-eq-confused: Cannot distinguish an expression from an equation
errors.ind-frac-power-ignored: Takes the root but ignores the numerator
errors.sq-termwise: Squares each term separately: (a+b)² = a² + b²
errors.ineq-not-flipped: Divides by a negative without reversing the inequality
errors.pi-last-term-only: Gives the last factor instead of the product
errors.cs-coefficient-not-halved: Does not halve the coefficient of x
errors.prob-value-as-count: Uses the total as the number of ways
errors.trig-sin-cos-swapped: Swaps the exact values of sine and cosine
errors.trans-order: Reverses the order of undoing operations
errors.log-sum-inside: Thinks log a + log b = log(a + b)
errors.deriv-power-not-reduced: Multiplies by the power but does not reduce the power by one
errors.quad-sign-roots: Gets the signs of both roots wrong
errors.sigma-last-term-only: Gives the last term instead of the sum
errors.count-no-repeats: Disallows repeated choices in a count that allows repeats
errors.cs-vertex-sign: Gets the sign of a vertex coordinate wrong
errors.deriv-power-not-multiplied: Reduces the power but does not multiply by the original power
